title: TrajectoryPrediction
description: Predicted future tip trajectory for one hand from one reference frame (Phase 01 contract; produced by an Anticipator: rule-based Phase 05, learned Phases 09-12). The PRIMARY output is positions[]; every aux field is optional and auxiliary (trajectory-first, ADR-0007). docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.6.

t_capture.description: Reference time t_ref: the t_capture of the latest frame the prediction was allowed to see. Step k (1-based) is at t_ref + k * dt_step.

model_hash.description: SHA-256 of the loaded model artefact (verified at load, Phase 13); null for rule-based anticipators.

K.description: Number of predicted steps = len(positions) (tunable; README section 14).

dt_step.description: Seconds between consecutive predicted steps (> 0) when t_offsets_s is null. Horizon H = K * dt_step (uniform) or the last offset (sparse).

t_offsets_s.description: Null = uniform steps: step k (1-based) is at t_capture + k * dt_step. Otherwise K strictly increasing positive offsets from t_capture, one per position - for anticipators that predict a few sparse horizons (e.g. Phase 09 C-GBDT head iv at k in {K/2, K}); geometry intersects the polyline as given and never interpolates missing steps into a denser trajectory.

positions.description: K predicted tip positions, ROI-normalized, in time order. PRIMARY OUTPUT; never empty (a prediction without a trajectory is a DirectPrediction, a different, diagnostic-only record).

uncertainty.description: K rows of per-step uncertainty values; layout named by uncertainty_kind. Reserved nullable in V1 (Phase 12 Open Question).

uncertainty_kind.description: e.g. 'sigma_xy' (2 values: std x, std y) or 'cov_xy' (3 values: var x, var y, cov). Null when uncertainty is null.

aux.description: Auxiliary heads (Phase 11). All nullable. Never used INSTEAD of positions[] to decide a strike: geometry decides (ADR-0007).

tti.description: Predicted Time-to-Impact in seconds from t_capture (t_ref).

zone_logits.description: Z raw scores aligned with zone_ids.

zone_ids.description: Zone id per logit position; must be present when zone_logits is.

intensity_proxy.description: Kinematic intensity proxy (README section 6); not force.
